subject: My Broken Heart
text: Due to battery protection, this achievement only triggers if the reward event is repeated.

evidence.quote: Due to the battery protection you wont be able to trigger this achievement unless you repeat that event.

subject: My Broken Heart
text: If there is no save before that event, a manual unlock can be requested.

evidence.quote: If you don't have a save before that event you can request a manual unlock

subject: My Broken Heart

subject: My Broken Heart

subject: World map

evidence.quote: always save after entering a dungeon or getting a token (Duh)

subject: Gold Skulltula token
text: The emulator can crash randomly, and a token is lost if the game was not saved.

evidence.quote: The problem is that the emulator crashes randomly and makes it so you loose the token if you didn't save.

subject: World map
text: Dungeons are not counted by the world map zone mark and have their own Skulltula mark on their own map inside the dungeon.

evidence.quote: But it does NOT count the dungeons. Those have their own mark, on their own map inside the dungeon.

subject: World map
text: A zone such as Death Mountain counts its smaller areas, such as Death Mountain Trail and Goron City.

evidence.quote: Example: Death Mountain ( Map Zone) counts Death Mountain trail, Goron City, etc.

subject: Family Reunion
text: The reward for collecting all Gold Skulltulas is 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: Can't believe, after all these years, the prize for getting them all is a measly 200 Rupees.

subject: Family Reunion
text: Returning to the reward NPC reportedly gives another 200 Rupees each visit.

evidence.quote: it's more than 200 rupees though, because every time you go to him, he'll give you another 200, so effectively the prize is infinite money.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Finding all Gold Skulltulas requires going through all dungeons except Ganons Castle.

evidence.quote: Because you have to go through all the dungeons except Ganons Castle to find them all

subject: Zora's Domain Skulltula
text: A player at 99 of 100 Skulltulas found Zora's Domain as the only zone not completed.

evidence.quote: 99/100 with Zora's Domain being the only one not completed.

subject: Zora's Domain Skulltula
text: As adult Link, the Zora's Domain Skulltula requires the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote: As adult Link, you need the Silver Gauntlets.

subject: Zora's Domain Skulltula
text: Go to Zora's Fountain near the great fairy cave, preferably at night, to reach the Skulltula.

evidence.quote: Head over to Zora's Fountain and over to where the great fairy cave is (go at night, just to be safe).

subject: Zora's Domain Skulltula
text: Pick up the grey boulder, toss it, bomb the rock beneath, drop down, pass the hidden enemies to a ladder, and the Skulltula is at the top along the left wall.

evidence.quote: There will be a grey boulder that you can pick up due to the gauntlets. Toss it, bomb the rock beneath, and drop down. There will be several enemies hidden (use the Eye) and head on by them to a ladder. The skulltula will be at the top of the area along the left wall.

subject: Achievement trigger
text: If the reward does not trigger, restart the emulator, make sure achievements are loaded, and repeat that event.

evidence.quote: Restart the emulator and make sure the achievements are loaded then repeat that event.

subject: Golden scale early glitch
text: Catching a fish of 10 lbs or more and then doing the golden scale early glitch locks you out of the heart piece.

evidence.quote: Note however that if you catch a fish >=10 lbs and do the glitch to get it early, you'll be locked out of getting the heart piece.

subject: Expert Angler
text: A 19-pound fish still gets the golden scale.

evidence.quote: 19 lbs will still get you the golden scale!

subject: Expert Angler
text: A large fish is under the log sticking out of the lake, and a 19-pound catch there earns the golden reward.

evidence.quote: There's a big fish hanging out under that log sticking out of the lake. I caught one weighing 19 lbs there — enough to earn the golden reward.

subject: Expert Angler
text: Walk onto the log to its halfway point, cast, and when the fish bites pull down to the bottom right to reel it in.

evidence.quote: Slowly walk from the side of the water lilies onto the log in the water, up to the halfway point. Cast the fishing rod and wait for the fish to bite. Once it bites, immediately pull down to the bottom right and reel it in.
